verdicts.decision_note: Message 18 authorizes the model build and availability-payment evidence but does not establish the Case F/Case G comparison; the earlier freelancer description is not unambiguously accepted for this target.
The source establishes the required conclusion about user-fee insufficiency, which belongs to REQ_AVAILABILITY_PAYMENT_NECESSITY_EVIDENCE rather than changing the scenario-comparison behavior.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports that the reworked financial model contains separate cash flows for both funding scenarios.

missing_event_candidates.description: The client requires the model to demonstrate that user fees alone are insufficient and that an availability-style payment is necessary.
